title: A Practical Method for Generating String Counterfactuals

bias_targets.methodology: Generating string counterfactuals by intervening on the gender concept in the representation space, analyzing semantic shifts using Pointwise Mutual Information (PMI), and evaluating the reduction of gender bias in profession classification (using the BiasBios dataset) by measuring the Root Mean Square (RMS) gap in True Positive Rates (TPR) between genders after counterfactual data augmentation.
